cards.card_text: God says He selected the Levites as a ___ to Aaron, dedicated to the LORD to serve at the Tent of Meeting.
cards.verse_text: Behold, I Myself have selected your fellow Levites from the Israelites as a gift to you, dedicated to the LORD to perform the service for the Tent of Meeting.
cards.snippet: …selected your fellow Levites from the Israelites as a gift to you, dedicated to the LORD to perform the service for the Tent of Meeting.

cards.card_text: It's dedicated to the LORD, for burning fragrant incense before Him and for setting out the showbread continuously.
